analysis.headline: Higher usage; a lower-cost registered plan is available
analysis.explanation: The bill rose from {{previous_bill}} to {{bill_total}} ({{bill_change}}); daily usage increased {{daily_change}}. The periods were {{feb_days}} days in February and {{march_days}} days in March. Usage is above peers, whose average was {{peer_kwh}} across {{peer_count}} homes, by {{peer_difference}}. Weather association points to heating, but the model extrapolates beyond its training range; its unexplained residual is {{weather_residual}}, so weather is not a proven cause. No anomaly was flagged.
actions: Review heating schedules and thermostat settings to understand the usage increase.
